column2: Front view of an adult upper chest and neck silhouette with a tunneled hemodialysis catheter: the catheter enters the right internal jugular vein in the neck, runs under the skin of the upper right chest, and exits the skin below the collarbone with two short external limbs with clamps. A small coral glow around the exit site on the chest. Anatomically plausible, simple.
An adult forearm seen from the inner side with a visible slightly bulging arteriovenous fistula vein near the wrist, a small coral patch of redness on the vein. Simple and respectful, no blood.
Simple anatomical icon of the urinary tract: two kidneys, two ureters and a bladder, front view, with the bladder highlighted in coral. Anatomically correct, minimal.

Simple anatomical icon of a pair of human lungs with the trachea and bronchi, front view, with the lower part of the right lung highlighted in coral as an area of pneumonia. Anatomically correct, minimal.
An adult lower leg (shin and calf) in side view with a coral area of skin redness and swelling on the shin representing cellulitis. Simple and respectful.
